title: Flow Graph Default Element Strokes
description: Flow graph nodes, handles, and edges still default to emphasized color instead of element gray.
summary: Fixed flow graph default strokes to element gray across nodes, handles, edges, and labels. Updated serializeGraphVelloThemePaletteJson: edgeStroke/wireStroke/labelFill default to element; hover states use emphasized. Fixed DAG paint_scene to use theme handle fill/stroke (replacing hardcoded secondary colors by handle role) and per-edge hover/selection stroke colors. Selected node labels now use emphasized fill. Aligned puzzle2d Vello theme serializer with the same element-default pattern. Added dag_handle_and_edge_stroke_use_theme_defaults test.
